assertion_independence: finished["head"] == repaired checks a receipt against the delivered input and is not sufficient landing proof alone; the test independently reads remote merge-base, committed source, primary commit count and unchanged document bytes. No assertion was counted as proving a push merely because it echoes the requested head. The failed/stale gate refusal has no assertion, recorded as a blocking finding.

findings.text: blocking: _delivered_repair accepts a complete manifest plus commit ancestry without reading or validating a fresh gate for that repaired head; finish_pending_landings then pushes it directly, and crew_run_commands.py:3213 takes this branch before normal gate validation, so a repair with a failed, missing or stale gate can land despite the required own-gate rerun; require revision-bound repair gate evidence before selecting it and add refusal cases without promoting the run again.

gate_revision_note: Head gate at 6e51af7316fbb85e6b67b9b2fd97f5d14fc38224; final reviewed commit changes only the evidence HTML, verified from its diff.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the six source commits from b0708be48a046eb6c3371fa2f73021470bdcb153 through 9f88e600fbd4fe91c7af015ffd859d9530196b92; their final seven-file diff preserves promotion records but pending_landing.py:131 accepts repaired heads without fresh gate evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: The live plan section s3 and source node done_when require real bare-remote landings and repair; node-rechecked.log records four passing cases, negative-control-resumed.log records three failing repair cases, and importer gate logs retain the same three failure IDs at base and head.
item_verdicts.goal: The source node goal in its live pointer is to return real landing conflicts for repair; reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:34 and pending_landing.py:144 implement that flow, with a blocking gap in repair-gate validation.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md names six commits and completed baseline_suite/after_suite logs, whose actual summaries and failure IDs agree with its four-pass head and three-failure base claims.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source live pointer node.write_paths includes all seven changed files, including coordinator-granted reckon/crew/pending_landing.py documented in resume-1-advice.txt.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_conflicting_landing_is_repaired.py:185 guards missing outcomes and :278 guards missing remote ancestry, but :249 supplies a successful dummy gate and never tests refusal of failed or stale repair evidence.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_conflicting_landing_is_repaired.py exercises real git conflicts and remote ancestry, and source node-rechecked.log, negative-control-resumed.log and importer logs record completed results at the stated code revisions.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/merge.py:76 extends MergeError, recovery_repair_dispatch.py:34 uses the existing repair-record and resume helpers, and new names describe mechanisms without forbidden labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:34 records pinned conflict advice and resumes the owner, but pending_landing.py:131 permits completion without verifying the repaired head's gate.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches for conflict handling, repair dispatch, completed-delivery selection and landing fixtures located owners in merge.py, recovery_repair_dispatch.py, queue_landing.py, pending_landing.py and tests/helpers/landing_repository.py, which the additions extend or call.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path is in the source live pointer node.write_paths, with pending_landing.py explicitly authorized by resume-1-advice.txt and all changes serving conflict repair.
